comparison.objective: Press a servo horn onto the zero-indexed tooth of a 25-tooth spline.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine coaxial and angular indexing followed by controlled axial press fitting.
comparison.success_condition: Horn seated flush at index zero within stated position/tilt/angle tolerances, released and still for 1 s; wrong-tooth seating fails under the applicable version.
comparison.reason: Coaxial alignment is shared, but this record tests indexed press fitting and final orientation, whereas the candidate tests impact fracture of installed tangs plus recovery of four free fragments.
